# Platform parity evidence map

Parity belongs to the specifically tagged assertions, not to an entire product area.
The tests below bind invented public fixtures to repeated native captures or executed
official Microsoft packages. Private source exports, native identities, ownership
journals and raw recordings remain in the external developer workbench.

| Area | Evidence and assertions |
| --- | --- |
| Power Pages | [Frontend evidence](frontend-parity-evidence.md): literal Liquid filters/language, native include context, rendered source-selected controls and client metadata. Local HTTP integration is tested separately from native browser observations. |
| Model-driven | [Frontend evidence](frontend-parity-evidence.md): attributes, collections, events, control options/validity, presentation, dirty state and independently recorded backend save Targets. |
| Canvas | [Package evidence](canvas-code-apps-package-evidence.md), [native draft fixture](canvas-draft-input-native.json) and [browser replay](../../test-browser/canvas-native-input.test.mjs): source-bound draft editing/cancel/discard. Official Power Fx evaluation proves only the reproduced language expressions. |
| Code Apps | [Package evidence](canvas-code-apps-package-evidence.md), [native context fixture](code-apps-context-native.json) and [host replay](../code-apps-native-context.test.mjs): selected typed host relationships, authored query values and resolved-context caching. The SDK bridge fixture is a separate package guarantee. |
| Portal Web API | [Existing reader assertions](../webapi-error-details.test.mjs) and [paired reader fixture](webapi-native-portal-reader.json), with explicit observed-site configuration. Portal permissions, visitor identity and error envelopes require portal captures; Dataverse captures do not qualify them. |
| Dataverse Web API | [Typed input/query tests](../webapi-native-contract.test.mjs) and [existing scalar-reader matrix](../dataverse-scalar-reader-http.test.mjs): exact selected native status/code/message guarantees, separately from local diagnostic and safety contracts. |
| Plugins | Existing individually tagged plugin/CLR suites retain their recorded guarantees. Frontend and HTTP evidence do not upgrade plugin expectations. |

[Query reader cases](../dataverse-query-reader.test.mjs) bind all 63 original
status, error-code and message cases to their complete source universe. Ten
additional cases use [six OData 8.3 cases](dataverse-query-six-case-facts.json),
[one OData 7.20 case](dataverse-query-one-case-facts.json) and
[three OData 7.20 cases](dataverse-query-three-case-facts.json), each with two
native HTTP observations and source-relative typed-property mappings. The last
three package observations used Windows .NET Framework; those observations do
not identify the runtime or package version deployed by Dataverse. The enclosing
test's separate store-nonmutation assertion is not qualified by these captures.

Generated test cases, expression counts and HTTP executions measure different things.
They overlap and must not be summed as distinct platform features. A native capture
does not by itself prove local replay or final-tree validation; those receipts remain
separate. Unsupported host seams and unrecorded assertions keep their own test kinds.

Use [test kinds](../../../docs/test-kinds.md) for evidence and change rules and
[recording frontend contracts](../../docs/frontend-contract-recording.md) for reusable probes.
